startedBy.speaker: Eltrys

reply: The Forsworn? Strange. Well, I hope the Eight give you more peace in the future, for what it's worth.

startedBy.speaker: Eltrys

reply: I'm so sorry. I hope the Eight give you more peace in the future.

startedBy.speaker: Eltrys
reply: Oh, I think you dropped this. Some kind of note. Looks important.

startedBy.speaker: Eltrys
startedBy.prompt: I don't have time for this nonsense.
reply: You want to walk away? Fine. But there's going to be no justice for that poor woman. No one to care what happened to her.

firstObjective.text: Go to the Shrine of Talos

movedBy.plain: It starts by itself from the start of the game.

movedBy.plain: It starts by itself from the start of the game.

movedBy.speaker: Eltrys
movedBy.prompt: You want me to find out why.
reply: This has been going on for years. And all I've been able to find is murder and blood. I need help.
Please. You find out why that woman was attacked, who's behind Weylin and the Forsworn, and I'll pay you for any information you bring me.

movedBy.speaker: Uraccen
reply: If you're asking, that means you're the new lifer. Tough luck, friend. Those guards sold you out but good.
No one talks to Madanach, I'm afraid. Not without getting past Borkul the Beast.
And you don't want to talk to Borkul the Beast.
movedBy.conditions: No One Escapes Cidhna Mine stage 200 not done; No One Escapes Cidhna Mine stage < 10; the speaker is Uraccen

startedBy.speaker: Uraccen
reply: Small blade. Easy to hide. I mean, sure, you could just swing a pickaxe into someone's face, but people tend to see that coming.
Got a problem with a prisoner? Get a shiv. Hear Grisvar has a spare, if you could get him to part with it.
startedBy.conditions: Shiv stage 10 not done; the speaker is Uraccen

startedBy.speaker: Borkul the Beast
reply: Then find one. That dung heap Grisvar's been known to make a few.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Borkul the Beast
the place you enter is Cidhna Mine; the place you enter is a habitation

firstObjective.text: Talk to Grisvar about getting a shiv

objective.text: Get a bottle of Skooma for Grisvar

movedBy.speaker: Grisvar the Unlucky
reply: Thank you, friend. Don't worry. I'll have that shiv ready for you.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Grisvar the Unlucky

startedBy.quest: CidhnaMineJailEventScene, a helper quest with Urzoga, Player

throughStartedBy.source: QF_MS02_00040A5E.fragment_48 on Skyrim.esm:040A5E (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp), through DialogueCrimeGuards (Generic crime dialogue)'s setupcidhnamine

startedBy.speaker: Urzoga gra-Shugurz
reply: Cidhna Mine's for prisoner scum only. Keep out.
startedBy.conditions: CidhnaMineJailEventScene stage 10 not done; the speaker is Urzoga gra-Shugurz

startedBy.speaker: Duach
reply: I'm a Forsworn. One of our raids went bad, and I got captured.
Would've been fine dying for The Reach with my kinsmen, but the Silver-Bloods want their ore mined, so they threw me in here.
startedBy.source: TIF__00072BE5.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:072BE5 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Uraccen
reply: A Nord nobleman I served was stabbed in the night. Wasn't me, but I knew I'd be blamed.
So I ran. Joined the Forsworn. Started killing. Got caught. Now I'm here.

startedBy.speaker: Uraccen
reply: I hear you're in for life. Sad. I'd get a shiv, if I was you, or maybe some skooma to drown your troubles.
startedBy.conditions: The Forsworn Conspiracy stage 100 done; the speaker is Uraccen
startedBy.source: TIF__000DB84B.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:0DB84B (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Uraccen
reply: My advice? Serve your time at the pickaxe and get out. You don't want to end up getting a shiv in the guts over a bottle of skooma.
startedBy.source: TIF__000DB84C.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:0DB84C (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Borkul the Beast
reply: Liar.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Borkul the Beast

startedBy.speaker: Borkul the Beast
startedBy.prompt: Horrible. My soul is heavy with guilt.
reply: Pah. The gods have a place for killers. You can't carry the burden? You're weak.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Borkul the Beast

startedBy.speaker: Borkul the Beast
startedBy.prompt: Exciting. I felt the rush of blood... and smiled.
reply: A true killer, like me. The gods put us here to fill their halls with souls. You'll fit in fine down here.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Borkul the Beast

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
